observations: Photo 0: Black Nikon DSLR body with a telephoto zoom lens attached, resting on a box printed 'McSteve ... Gadget Store'. 'Nikon' logo is legible on the pentaprism hump; the smaller text beneath it that would carry the model number is too blurred to read.

Photo 1: Top-down view of the lens barrel showing markings 'Nikon AF-P DX' and a focal-length scale (70/100/135/200/300), consistent with a 70-300mm zoom. The body's mode dial and a small 'EFFECTS' label are visible but no model name plate is shown.

Photo 2: Side view of the camera body showing visible wear, scuffing and paint loss on the hand-grip area. Front lens element is visible but only at low resolution; no close-up of the glass for fungus or scratches.
No photos show the LCD screen, a shutter-count menu, the battery, the charger, or the camera powered on.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI / MCSTEVE' overlay all three images; no additional angles or proof shots are provided.
Seller's new message is a verbal reassurance only; no new photo, video, or screenshot was supplied.

identity.kind: DSLR camera with telephoto zoom lens

claims.evidence: Nikon brand logo is legible in photo 0, but the 'D3400' model text on the body is too blurred/small to confirm in any photo.
Photo 1 shows 'Nikon AF-P DX' lens barrel with a 70-300 focal length scale.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: Seller repeats the claim in text only ('I tested it myself'); still no power-on shot, LCD screen, or sample image to confirm function.
No screenshot of the camera's shutter-count menu or EXIF data is provided, despite the reassurance.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens front element appears only at low resolution and no angled light test is shown to rule out haze or fungus.
Neither battery nor charger appears in any of the three photos; seller's text does not substitute for a photo.
No internal or service-sticker evidence is visible; this cannot be judged from external photos or from a verbal claim.

risks.risk: Exact camera model cannot be confirmed, and different Nikon DSLR bodies carry very different values.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate/model text on the front of the body (below the Nikon logo).
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced as any specific model; treated as unidentified Nikon DSLR body

risks.risk: Visible wear/scuffing on the grip (photo 2) may indicate heavier use than the claimed low shutter count suggests.
risks.proof: Photo or screen-record of the shutter count from the camera's menu or a shutter-count-reading app.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavy-use cosmetic condition, shutter count treated as unknown/high

risks.risk: Lens could have internal fungus, haze, or fine scratches not visible at this photo resolution.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens elements against a bright light source, front and rear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with possible optical defect

risks.risk: Sensor or shutter fault (dead pixels, mirror/shutter issue, autofocus fault) not demonstrable from static photos or words.
risks.proof: A sample photo taken with the camera and a short video of it powering on and firing the shutter.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, i.e. worst case non-functional

risks.risk: Battery and charger authenticity/inclusion not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of the battery (with Nikon markings) and charger together with the camera.

proof_requests: Clear, in-focus photo of the body nameplate showing the model number (e.g. 'D3400').
Photo or screen recording of the in-camera menu showing shutter actuation count.
Close-up photos of the lens front and rear elements against light to check for fungus/haze/scratches.
Short video of the camera powering on, focusing, and firing the shutter, plus a sample photo taken with it.
Photo of the battery and charger together with the camera to confirm inclusion and originality.
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video adds no verifiable evidence; the model text is still unreadable and all condition claims remain unverifiable from the images provided.
